overall: The AG found the Off Leash Area Working Group is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law, because it is not a Commission subcommittee and falls within the Connelly exception, so there was no violation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Off Leash Area Working Group is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law and failed to conduct its meetings as one.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that the Group is not a public body and therefore there was no violation of the Open Meeting Law as alleged.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Working Group is a subcommittee of the Parks and Recreation Commission, raised in correspondence to the Mayor and addressed in the Commission's response.
allegations.key_passage: For these reasons, we find that the Group is not a subcommittee of the Commission.
